title: The Little Bean
logline: A nervous little Ethiopian coffee bean survives picking, roasting and grinding, and discovers the reward is a room full of laughing people.
audience: My family and friends, watching on their phones
intent: They should laugh at the bean's troubles, then feel warm about sitting together and coming together over coffee.
style_block: Warm hand-painted cartoon look, soft golden light, gentle paper grain, simple rounded shapes, rich earthy colours of Ethiopian highlands

characters.description: small glossy coffee bean character with two tiny round eyes and a small smile; bright red when ripe, dark brown after roasting
characters.reference_prompt: Character sheet of a small glossy coffee bean character with two tiny round eyes and a small smile; bright red when ripe, dark brown after roasting, front view, side view, nervous face, happy face, plain background

characters.description: elderly Ethiopian grandmother in a white netela shawl and traditional habesha kemis, round kind face, small gold earrings, cartoon style
characters.reference_prompt: Character sheet of an elderly Ethiopian grandmother in a white netela shawl and traditional habesha kemis, round kind face, small gold earrings, cartoon style, front view, side view, smiling, plain background

music.caption: Gentle warm instrumental, soft strings, light hand percussion and a plucked krar-like melody, playful and tender, no lead melody

cues.note: playful, a little tense during roasting and grinding
warm, resolves, theme returns at the family gathering

shots.reason: Show where we are: green Ethiopian hillside, the bean hanging on a branch.
shots.image_prompt: Green coffee hillside with a branch of coffee cherries, one small bean character on the branch, centred, golden morning light
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in slowly, leaves sway gently

narration.text: እኔ ትንሽ ቡና ነኝ። የምኖረው በኢትዮጵያ ኮረብታ ላይ፣ ከቅርንጫፍ ተንጠልጥዬ ነው።
narration.english_subtitle: I am a little coffee bean. I live on a hillside in Ethiopia, hanging from a branch.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: Meet the character and show its personality: proud but nervous.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the red glossy bean character on a branch looking nervous but proud, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds still, the bean blinks and trembles slightly

narration.text: ቀይ ሆኜ ደምቄያለሁ። ዛሬ ትልቅ ቀን እንደሆነ ይሰማኛል።
narration.english_subtitle: I have turned red and shiny. I feel that today is a big day.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: The adventure begins with a small surprise.
shots.image_prompt: A pair of cartoon hands picking the bean from the branch, bean looks shocked, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera stays still, the hand lifts the bean gently upward

narration.text: ድንገት አንድ እጅ ቀነጠበችኝ! ወይኔ፣ ምን እየሆነ ነው?
narration.english_subtitle: Suddenly a hand plucked me! Oh no, what is happening?
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: Compress travel into one shot and add a bumpy-road joke.
shots.image_prompt: Old truck loaded with sacks on a bumpy dirt road through green hills, one bean peeking out of a sack, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera tracks slowly alongside, truck bounces lightly

narration.text: ከጓደኞቼ ጋር በጆንያ ተጭኜ በጉድጓድ መንገድ ተንከባለልኩ። እያንዳንዱ ጉብታ ይሰማኛል!
narration.english_subtitle: Packed in a sack with my friends, I bounced down a bumpy road. I felt every bump!
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: The funny low point: the roasting pan.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the bean character in a black roasting pan over charcoal, sweating drops, wide eyes, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera holds still, tiny sweat drops and heat shimmer

narration.text: ከዚያ ድስት ላይ ወደቅሁ። ሞቀ፣ ደግሞ ሞቀ፣ በጣም ሞቀ! ሁሉንም ቡና እንዲህ ያደርጋሉ እንዴ?
narration.english_subtitle: Then I landed in the pan. Hot, hotter, so hot! Do they do this to every coffee?
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: Transformation: the bean comes out changed.
shots.image_prompt: Dark brown roasted bean character, smiling slightly, wisps of fragrant smoke around it, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke drifts slowly upward, camera pulls back slightly

narration.text: ጭሱ ሲጠፋ ግን አዲስ ቀለም ነበረኝ፤ ጥቁር ቡናማ፣ እና የሚያጓጓ መዓዛ።
narration.english_subtitle: But when the smoke cleared I had a new colour, dark brown, and a wonderful smell.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: A quick comic beat: the grinding.
shots.image_prompt: Wooden mortar and pestle with the dark bean character looking worried inside, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Pestle comes down gently, small shake of the frame

narration.text: ከዚያ ተወቀጥኩ። እሺ፣ ይህን ክፍል አልወደድኩትም።
narration.english_subtitle: Then I got pounded. Okay, I did not like this part.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: Arrival at the ceremony: the setting and the mood change.
shots.image_prompt: Clay jebena on glowing charcoal in a cosy room, steam rising, fresh grass on the floor, popcorn bowl nearby, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in slowly, steam curls upward

narration.text: በመጨረሻ በጀበና ውስጥ ገባሁ፤ ከከሰሉ ላይ እየተንቆጠቆጥኩ መዓዛዬ ቤቱን ሞላው።
narration.english_subtitle: At last I was in the jebena on the charcoal, and my smell filled the house.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.reason: The warm centre of the film: grandmother pours.
shots.image_prompt: Grandmother pouring coffee from a jebena into small cups on a tray, smiling, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera stays still, the coffee stream flows, steam rises

narration.text: አያት በትናንሽ ስኒዎች አፈሰሰችኝ፤ ሁሉም ዙሪያዋ ተቀመጡ።
narration.english_subtitle: Grandmother poured me into little cups, and everyone sat down around her.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller

shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a cosy room, grandmother and family silhouettes sitting together raising small cups, laughing, centred
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pulls back slowly, warm light glows

narration.text: ያኔ ገባኝ፤ ይህን ሁሉ ያለፍኩት ሰዎች አብረው ሲስቁ ለማየት ነበር።
narration.english_subtitle: Then I understood: I went through all of it to see people laugh together.
narration.style: warm, playful, a little dramatic, like a small funny storyteller
